d:
Navanbar aate hi rajdhani dilli men tapman girne ke sath pradushan ka star barhne lagta hai. hava ki gunvatta itni kharab ho jati hai ki sarkar logon ko gharon men rahne ki salah dene lagti hai. sath hi khel pratiyogitaen bhi talne ki salah hoti hai.
Lekin khilari apna abhyas chhor nahin sakte. vah apni trening jari rakhte hain. aise men khule maidanon men abhyas karne vale khilariyon ke lie pradushan ek bari chunauti ban jata hai.
